abilities.name: Call Leviathan

rank_config.mDescription: Rips a hole into the mapped B9-Epsilon(s) psuedoquadrant of the Ether, known habitation of Leviathan.

abilities.gameplay: Scale in, maintain mQuantity independently tracking appendages, fire straight EtherBolts with mDamage, then scale out; bolts live 100 ticks plus fade and contact only under caster authority.
abilities.authority: Caster authority selects targets, creates EtherBolts, and applies their contacts; presentation actors are replicated snapshots.
abilities.cleanup: Leviathan owns its appendage list and retires after scale-out; EtherBolts retire on contact or post-100-tick fade; region teardown stops loop renewal.

audio.trigger: renewed while the ether actor is active

abilities.name: Planewalker

rank_config.mDescription: Your wizard steps halfway into the mapped 9th-Sigma pseudoquadrant of the ether, which is known to be devoid of matter.
rank_config.mQDescription: become one with the ether plane

abilities.gameplay: Enable matterless plane state for mDuration, save the prior primary, force runtime skill 80 Plane Orb, merge by maximum remaining duration, and restore the saved primary on toggle-off or expiry.
abilities.authority: The authoritative player owns modifier duration, collision flag 0x10, saved-primary restoration, and Plane Orb contacts.
abilities.cleanup: Modifier removal at 0x00623810 calls 0x0052F470, clears plane state, restores selection, and stops renewing plane ambience.

audio.trigger: renewed while plane state is active

abilities.name: Phasing

rank_config.mDescription: A quick and limited planar teleport in the direction you are facing.
rank_config.mQDescription: A limited teleport through the ether

abilities.gameplay: Probe at most 20 forward positions along cast heading, relocate to the first collision-clear point, and update world membership atomically.
abilities.authority: Only the authoritative simulation resolves collision and commits the destination; observers consume the resulting position and traversal event.
abilities.cleanup: Traversal children are world-owned and self-expire; rejected probes spend no extra cooldown beyond the native cast gate.

abilities.name: Ring of Fire

rank_config.mDescription: Surrounds the caster with an expanding ring of fire and brimstone that pushes back enemies.

abilities.gameplay: Create exactly 30 moving fire segments at 12-degree steps with jitter and one expanding Shockwave; the wave damages, dazzles once per target, and pushes tracked targets radially.
abilities.authority: Caster authority creates segments and the wave, owns unique-target contact, and applies radial displacement.
abilities.cleanup: Each fire segment follows Fire lifetime/fade; Shockwave removes itself after expansion and releases its unique-target list.

abilities.name: Firewalker

rank_config.mDescription: Your wizard leaves a trail of fire as he walks.
rank_config.mQDescription: drop a trail of fire behind you
mStats:
Damage: %d:mDamage% / sec"
	"Flame Duration: %d:mDuration% seconds"
	"Hoards %d:mHoard% mana when active

abilities.gameplay: Toggle progression +0x8DC; while active the player tick emits damaging Fire_Goodguy trail patches and reserves exactly 50 MP as an absolute hoard.
abilities.authority: The authoritative player owns toggle, reserve, trail cadence, and Fire contacts; patches carry owner identity.
abilities.cleanup: Toggle-off stops new patches and removes the reserve; existing patches complete their own 200-tick fade/contact lifetime.

audio.trigger: toggle activation with native pitch triplet

abilities.name: Magic Storm

rank_config.mDescription: Spawn a small but intense electro-magic thunderstorm.
rank_config.mQDescription: spawn a small but intense storm

abilities.gameplay: Spawn a stationary storm for 1000 active ticks, randomly select hostile targets at the native 30..120 cadence, roll mDamage1..mDamage2, and generate lightning geometry; Magic Tornado upgrades frequency and duration without changing the base placement contract.

timing.strike_reset_ticks: uniform integer 30..120, divided by tornado frequency factor

art.records: cloud particles plus record 11 lightning children

abilities.authority: Caster authority chooses targets, consumes RNG, and applies damage; all strike points and short energy state are snapshot-visible.
abilities.cleanup: After 1000 active ticks the cloud fades, ceases target queries, then retires and stops ambient renewal.

abilities.name: Prismatic Shock

rank_config.mDescription: Cast a manly prismatic miasma that makes foes more susceptible to lightning.

abilities.gameplay: Emit the prismatic cast wave, query the hostile rectangle, and attach/merge a duration modifier that doubles lightning susceptibility.
abilities.authority: Caster authority owns rectangle membership and modifier attachment; modifier duration/status is replicated with the target.
abilities.cleanup: World-owned wave children self-expire; the target-owned modifier expires or merges by native modifier rules.

abilities.name: Ring of Ice

rank_config.mDescription: Surrounds the caster with an expanding ring of ice that freezes enemies into immobility.

abilities.gameplay: Create three ice-blast bursts, radial debris, and an expanding wave which applies ColdSlow or Frozen once per target, optional FrostBurn, and configured freeze payload.
abilities.authority: Caster authority owns the unique-target list, status selection, contact, and optional item-effect branch.
abilities.cleanup: FreezeWave and registered burst children self-expire after expansion/fade and release target references.

abilities.name: Earthquake

rank_config.mDescription: Shaking the earth causes a tremendous disruption in your foe's ability to concentrate, pursue, and aim.

abilities.gameplay: Shake the world for mDuration, every 30 ticks query hostile actors and disrupt up to half after shuffling; it deals no direct damage.
abilities.authority: Caster authority shuffles targets and cancels/pauses actions; world shake and debris are presentation state.
abilities.cleanup: Counter zero retires the actor, clears world-shake contribution, releases its pointer list, and stops quake-loop renewal.

abilities.name: Raise Golem

rank_config.mDescription: Summons a golem to both deliver and receive beatings.

abilities.gameplay: Enforce one summon or two with Iron Golem, assemble at ages 0/50/100/200, activate contact at age 400, acquire/chase/attack hostiles, and reflect incoming primary damage when upgraded.
abilities.authority: Caster authority owns cap replacement, AI, target identity, contact, reflection, death, and child Knockback creation.
abilities.cleanup: No natural expiry; replacement, death, disconnect, or region teardown retires body/AI and releases child collections while registered fragments finish independently.

abilities.name: Stoneskin

rank_config.mDescription: Temporarily renders your wizard impervious to all physical and magical harm.

abilities.gameplay: Attach a duration modifier which sets actor flag 0x1 and makes the wizard impervious; reapplication retains the greater remaining duration.
abilities.authority: The authoritative player owns modifier duration and rejects physical/magical damage while active.
abilities.cleanup: Expiry or teardown clears invulnerability/tint and emits the removal presentation exactly once.

abilities.name: Teleport

rank_config.mDescription: Immediately teleports your wizard to the safest place nearby.

abilities.gameplay: Ask the world relocation query for a safe nearby destination and atomically move the wizard to the accepted point.
abilities.authority: Only authoritative world collision selects and commits the destination; observers render the relocation event.
abilities.cleanup: Registered burst children self-expire; rejected relocation leaves no persistent actor.

abilities.name: Magic Circle

rank_config.mDescription: Surrounds the caster with a magic circle that slows time, boosts healing, and boosts mana recovery.
rank_config.mQDescription: slows time, boosts life and mana

abilities.gameplay: Maintain a 1500-tick circle, every 10 ticks slow eligible enemies and restore local MP at twice normal recovery; retain the shipped inert HP branch.
abilities.authority: Caster authority owns slow attachment and local MP recovery; circle/color/lifetime state is replicated.
abilities.cleanup: At zero lifetime the circle unregisters; world-owned spin-away children finish independently.

abilities.name: Magic Trap

rank_config.mDescription: Binds your primary spell into a trap that detonates when an enemy walks near.  The longer the trap lies idle, the more damage it does.
rank_config.mQDescription: bind a spell into a trap

abilities.gameplay: Bind the current primary element and base damage into a trap, charge linearly to full over 800 ticks, poll every 25 ticks, then detonate once for charge-scaled damage and the element-specific status.
abilities.authority: Caster authority derives the primary payload, owns charge/query RNG, applies contacts/statuses, and removes the trap.
abilities.cleanup: Trigger is terminal and removes the trap after emitting world-owned children; ordinary teardown releases the Puppet without replaying trigger effects.

abilities.name: Dampen

rank_config.mDescription: Attempts to dampen hostile magic in an area around the caster.

abilities.gameplay: Remove hostile guided/fire/dark missiles in range, disrupt hostile casters, roll RandomInt(100) < 0x33 (51 accepted values despite the authored 50 percent display text) to dispel shields, and queue the 73-tick cast-spin action.

art.owner: dampen flash and additive wave children

abilities.authority: Caster authority owns projectile removal, action disruption, and shield-dispel RNG; action pose is replicated presentation.
abilities.cleanup: World children self-expire; cast spin is atomic except death and completes after its strict phase boundary.

abilities.name: Magic Shield

rank_config.mDescription: Surrounds the caster with a bubble that absorbs all physical and magical damage.

abilities.gameplay: Install or refresh mAbsorb on the wizard; incoming damage drains the pool and drives a 40-tick hit pulse. If Explosive Shield is learned, break damage is absorb times mDamage/100.
abilities.authority: Authoritative damage contact drains absorb and conditionally creates the radial break contact; pulse/break sequence is snapshot-visible.
abilities.cleanup: Break clears absorb and explosive factor after one particle/contact event; death, disconnect, and region teardown clear the residual pulse.

abilities.name: Acid Rain

rank_config.mDescription: Spawn a shower of hot acid.
rank_config.mQDescription: spawn a shower of hot acid

abilities.gameplay: Rain for 1500 active ticks, emit two drops per tick or five with Enhanced Effects, and after the startup delay shuffle hostile candidates and damage exactly min(n, floor(n/3)+1) every 25 ticks; damage is direct, not poison.
abilities.authority: Caster authority shuffles candidates and applies direct periodic damage; drops/residue are presentation state.
abilities.cleanup: The actor retires only after active lifetime and residue fade both end; loop renewal stops with residue ownership.

audio.trigger: renewed through active rain and residue

abilities.name: Fire Wall

rank_config.mDescription: Spawn a wall of burning flame.

abilities.gameplay: Create eleven independently damaging Fire_Goodguy patches at 30-unit intervals across the 300-unit line perpendicular to aim; each patch contacts nearby hostiles every third tick.

art.owner: Fire_Goodguy strip for every wall patch

abilities.authority: Caster authority resolves wall geometry, creates patches, and owns their repeated contacts.
abilities.cleanup: Patches fade and retire independently after the overwritten life scalar 7 reaches zero at 0.01 per tick (700 ticks); teardown stops their low-fire renewal.

abilities.name: Ether Drain

rank_config.mDescription: Rips a hole into the mapped Theta(g)-27 psuedoquadrant of the Ether, known to have a severe pressure differential.
rank_config.mQDescription: Rip a consuming hole into the ether

abilities.gameplay: Scale in for 40 ticks, refresh covered-cell candidate identities, pull actors and eligible loot inward, apply mDamage close to center for 1000 active ticks, consume empty/ordinary loot at center, then scale out for 20 ticks.
abilities.authority: Caster authority owns candidate identity arrays, forces, contacts, and loot consumption; visual children are replicated.
abilities.cleanup: Scale-out precedes retirement; destructor releases both PuppetRef arrays and cell lists while registered children self-expire.

abilities.name: Call Comet

rank_config.mDescription: Calls a large comet from the firmament, freezing enemies and dealing tremendous damage.

abilities.gameplay: Count down a falling comet while emitting ice-blast children, impact for mDamage, create the shared FreezeWave with mFreeze, query the area, restore world color, and retire.
abilities.authority: Caster authority owns countdown, impact query, damage/freeze contacts, and the spawned FreezeWave.
abilities.cleanup: Impact is terminal, restores world color, stops loop renewal, and leaves only registered debris/wave children to finish.

abilities.name: Turn Undead

rank_config.mDescription: Weakens lesser undead and causes them to flee the caster for a time.

abilities.gameplay: Affect only Skeleton, SkeletonArcher, SkeletonMage, and Zombie: turn them away, stamp flee timing, and scale attack strength by mWeaken once.
abilities.authority: Caster authority owns area membership, eligible-type filtering, one-time weaken stamp, heading, and flee deadline.
abilities.cleanup: The cast burst self-expires; each target returns to its ordinary behavior when its flee deadline elapses or it dies.

abilities.name: Mindstar

rank_config.mDescription: Supplements your cognitive nexus with certain magical energies, or possibly entities, boosting all skills.
mStats:
Boost: +1 to skills"
	"Hoards %d:mHoard%%% of mana when active

abilities.gameplay: Toggle progression +0x8DD, temporarily add one effective rank to every learned skill ID 8..77 except Mindstar itself, clamp to each compiled maximum, and reserve the configured percentage of MP.

timing.refresh: immediate on toggle and every normal progression refresh

abilities.authority: The authoritative progression component owns the toggle, temporary ranks, mana reserve, and overload shutdown.
abilities.cleanup: Toggle-off, mana overload, death/session reset, or actor teardown removes temporary ranks and reserve in one progression refresh.

abilities.name: Regenerate

rank_config.mDescription: Supplements your visceral node magically to increase your health recovery.
mStats:
Recover: 1 HP every 1.5 seconds"
	"Hoards %d:mHoard%%% of mana when active

abilities.gameplay: Toggle progression +0x8DE, reserve the configured percentage of MP, and while active add 1.5/tickRate HP per fixed update in addition to ordinary regeneration, capped at max HP.
abilities.authority: The authoritative progression component owns toggle, reserve, healing, cap, and overload shutdown.
abilities.cleanup: Toggle-off, mana overload, death/session reset, or actor teardown stops healing and removes reserve immediately.
